en: Oh, they're nothing but baseless rumors.
Everybody's bored, so they talk like that
to work off their daily frustrations, I'd say.
(This fellow's peace is a figment of his imagination.)
Ugly rumors about vampires and Dhampirs
never seem to die down, but
I've never heard of a single victim.
Rumors really are just rumors, after all.
Oh, I don't believe we've met.
I work at the Coast Guard.
The Coast Guard, is it?
Yes.
If you go south on Calstatt Road,
you'll find a church.
The Coast Guard is right across from it.
If anything comes up, please go there.
The Coast Guard's location...
Did you not understand my earlier directions?

en: <I've got it already>
<I want to hear it again>
I see.
Understood.
I'm about to have a meal.
I wonder what's on the menu today.
My wife is a wonderful cook...
Aha, so you're after my wife's cooking!
(Not knowing anything
really is a blessing, isn't it.)
No, it's nothing.
Captain Stelan says Calstatt
is a town that grew up almost overnight.
isn't easy work, is it?

en: I'd imagine smuggling and illegal entry are common, though?
(Maybe peace is all in how you look at it.)
Ugly rumors about vampires and Nosferatu
The Coast Guard?
<Understood>
<Please tell me once more>
Sorry, but could you tell me once more?

en: He's so carefree, but
will he be all right?
What's wrong? At this hour of the night?
Vampires and Nosferatu are
making a commotion outside!
It seems it was true after all!
I'll pretend I never heard that.
Mr. Klaus!
Hey, please wake up.
Please,
Don't take my peaceful life away from me.
Mr. Klaus, I'm so sorry!
What are you doing?!
Even if you become a Nosferatu,
you can still spend your days in peace...
A blade-wielder, hm? That's reassuring.
But you mustn't let human blood be shed
needlessly.
Understood, Master......
A blade-wielder... how interesting.
Make a bloody offering of all who defy you.
This is the "Knife Shop."
I'm Ernst. I'm the owner of this shop.
I was just sharpening a blade.
Sorry, we're not open yet.
Taking care of your blades is the key.
Even the handiest tool will end up
useless if you neglect it.
Are you taking good care of your tools?
Bring them here, and I'll take care of
any blade you've got.
From little knives to big
axes. We've got everything.
Welcome. Sorry the shop was closed
the other day.
I'm Ernst, the owner. Pleased to meet you.
The shop is full of blades I've sharpened.
Take your time and look around.
As a kid I went to trade school while
working, and after graduating I kept training
under my master learning blade-making.
